counting: Workspace and doctest function counts are reported separately. The five specialist contracts have 122 namespaced conditions; their repeated Rust executions are not added to the workspace count. Listing or compiling a target is not executing a test. limitations: This runner verifies local regression. Native platforms, performance and actual client/business acceptance require their own measurements.
